title: [Casual] A Danish Triathlete Just Smashed the Fastest Ironman Time Ever
summary: 丹麥鐵人 Magnus Ditlev 在 Ironman Florida 跑出 7:19:17，創下史上最快的 Ironman 成績。

p: Okay, so if you think a marathon is tough, try this: swim 3.8 kilometres, ride a bike for 180 kilometres, and then run a full marathon. That's an Ironman triathlon. And on Saturday at Ironman Florida, Denmark's Magnus Ditlev pulled off something nobody had ever done before.

Ditlev crossed the finish line in 7 hours, 19 minutes and 17 seconds. That's the fastest Ironman time ever recorded, beating Kristian Blummenfelt's 7:21:12 in Cozumel, Mexico. His bike split was crazy, too: 3:51:16 for 180 kilometres. It was the quickest full-distance bike ride anyone has ever done. By the time he got off the bike, he was more than 11 minutes ahead of everyone else, and he ended up winning by over 14 minutes.

What makes this even cooler is the comeback. Earlier this autumn, at the Ironman World Championship in Kona, Hawaii, Ditlev had a rough day and pulled out of the race. So yeah, he really bounced back.

Here's a fun fact for runners: Ditlev didn't have the best marathon of the day. American Matt Hanson ran 2:28:07, which was faster than anyone else in the field, and that jumped him up from outside the top three to third place. Just imagine running a 2:28 marathon after swimming and cycling for more than five hours!

The women's race was just as exciting. Switzerland's Alanis Siffert won in 8:07:37, smashing the old course record by almost 15 minutes. Her 2:45:03 marathon was a course record, too, and her overall time is one of the fastest ever for a woman at this distance.

One thing to keep in mind, though: some fans say it's not a true "world record." Why? Every Ironman course is different, and some are flatter or less windy than others. That's why a lot of people call it a "world best" instead. Either way, it was a seriously impressive day of racing.

list: triathlon (n.) 三項全能、鐵人三項（游泳＋自行車＋跑步） — She trained for a whole year before her first triathlon.
split (n.) 分段成績 — My second-half split was faster than my first half.
smash (a record) (v.) 大幅打破（紀錄） — She smashed her 10K personal best by two minutes.
field (n.) （比賽的）全體參賽者 — He was the youngest player in the field.
comeback (n.) 東山再起、捲土重來 — The badminton pair made an amazing comeback in the third game.
course record (n.) 賽道紀錄（某條賽道上的最佳成績） — The course record in this race has stood for ten years.
overall (adj.) 總體的、整體的 — Her overall time was 3 hours and 40 minutes.
impressive (adj.) 令人印象深刻的 — His footwork on the court is really impressive.
pull off (something) — 成功做到（很難的事）｜口語、輕鬆；正式文章常用 achieve / manage to。｜例：A: "You ran a sub-3 marathon?" B: "Yeah, I can't believe I pulled it off!"
pull out (of) — 退出（比賽、交易、計畫）｜口語和新聞都很常見，中性用法。｜例：A: "Are you still racing on Sunday?" B: "No, I pulled out. My knee hurts."
bounce back — 恢復、反彈、重新振作｜口語、中性；運動和股市新聞都常用。｜例：A: "The market bounced back today!" B: "Finally, after that awful Friday."
That's crazy! / ...was crazy — 太誇張了、超厲害（可褒可貶）｜非常口語，正式場合改用 remarkable / incredible。｜例：A: "He rode 180 km in under four hours." B: "That's crazy!"
either way — 不管怎樣、無論哪一種｜口語、中性，用來總結或表示結果都一樣。｜例：A: "Rain or sun tomorrow?" B: "Either way, we're running."
seriously + adj. — 真的很…、超…（加強語氣）｜口語；正式寫作改用 extremely / very。｜例：A: "How was the concert?" B: "Seriously good. You missed out!"

sections.h: 文法教學｜比較級與最高級 Comparatives & Superlatives
p: 今天文章裡用了好幾個「比較級」和「最高級」：

① "That's the fastest Ironman time ever recorded."　② "It was the quickest full-distance bike ride anyone has ever done."　③ "...which was faster than anyone else in the field."　④ "...some are flatter or less windy than others."

【規則】短形容詞（一到兩個音節）：加 -er / -est，例如 fast → faster → the fastest、quick → quicker → the quickest。子音結尾且前面是單一母音要重複字尾：flat → flatter；y 結尾改 i：windy → windier。長形容詞（多音節）：用 more / most，例如 more impressive、the most exciting。不規則：good → better → best、bad → worse → worst。反方向可用 less / least：less windy（比較不多風）。
【為什麼這裡用】運動新聞最愛比「快慢」和「紀錄」。最高級常搭配 ever、of the day、in the world、anyone has ever done，強調「史上第一」。句子③ "faster than anyone else" 是用比較級表達最高級的意思，等於 "the fastest in the field"，英文母語者很常這樣說。

【華人常見錯誤】1. 雙重比較：✗ more faster → ✓ faster。2. 最高級忘了 the：✗ He is fastest runner. → ✓ He is the fastest runner. 3. 「最…之一」名詞要用複數：✗ one of the fastest time → ✓ one of the fastest times。4. 中文說「快很多」，但英文不能用 very 修飾比較級：✗ very faster → ✓ much / a lot / far faster。5. than 和 then 拼錯：比較用 than。

例句：My second 10K was much faster than my first one.

1. What three sports are in an Ironman, and how long is the bike part?

3. Why do some people prefer to say "world best" instead of "world record"?

p: Do you think it's fair to compare times from different race courses, like Ironman races or city marathons? Why or why not? Try to use at least one comparative or superlative in your answer.

list: 理解題 1：Swimming (3.8 km), cycling and running (a full marathon). The bike part is 180 km.
理解題 2：Matt Hanson (USA) ran 2:28:07, and he finished third.
理解題 3：Because every Ironman course is different (some are flatter or less windy), so times can't be compared perfectly.

練習 2：best
